quotes.text: The 2024 tb-rust repo-update task made routes and scopes keyed by trust level. Its transform resolves those keys, then formats {owner} in email notification routes and scopes. Level 3 uses the sheriff Matrix room; other levels use an owner email route. D209693 requested changes for Try formatting and later accepted the correction. The landed commit was backed out for decision-task failures, then the same four file contents were relanded after the related CI grant was corrected. Treat this as a historical Taskgraph flow and verify current CI settings before reuse.
